host.usage.body:
Daedalus plugin host (core {0}) - plugin discovery/inspection/verification/audit.
Note: the host is the parent process of no MCP server. run-plugin / render-unit only print
the start command / systemd ExecStart fragment constructed from the manifest; systemd is the real executor
(plan decision 16); the host itself never spawns child processes.

Commands:
  list                 scan the plugin directory, printing id/name/version/type/runtime per plugin; broken ones are marked degraded
  inspect <id>         print the plugin's manifest details (checksums digest, tools, permissions)
  verify <id>          sha256 integrity check via the internal/plugin core; exit 0 on pass, 1+reason on failure
  run-plugin <id>      print the start command only (native: <exe> <args>; deno: deno run <args> <script>)
  render-unit <id>     output the systemd fragment (ExecStart= line) only, for build-time 76-daedalus-plugin-gen.sh

Plugin directory: default /opt/daedalus/plugins; override via DAEDALUS_PLUGIN_DIR env or -dir flag (flag wins).
